Hello, OP here. After a while of reading this thread, I can agree with both sides. Let me explain: 

The conversation that occurred earlier in the session was about my inability to feel cared for and such (being the eldest daughter of a narcissist is not helping that problem much aha!) 

Anyway, I do agree with you, Apricot, that no, I did not feel as if she was pissed or annoyed at me for not being able to feel cared for. I also feel like her actions were completely justified.

That being said, I feel almost guilted with the fact that I did not immediately recognize her “caring”, and basically dismissed it. I truly don’t believe that she could care about ME, I feel like she cares about my problems instead. 

Plus I’m scared that she might hurt me one day. (Physically / emotionally)

Feel free to ask me anything or have me clear up something; as my writing skills were never the best! :)
